items.headline: Huawei unveils Atlas 960 SuperPoD and new chip roadmap days before Trump-Xi summit
items.why: The launch shows China closing the AI hardware gap on its own silicon just as trade and tech talks with Washington begin, raising the stakes on any new export-control decisions.

sources.title: Huawei unveils new chip technologies as Chinese firm steps up the AI race with Nvidia

items.headline: Nvidia trades near a decade-low valuation despite accelerating profit growth
items.why: A forward earnings multiple under 17x even as revenue is projected to nearly double shows investors pricing in margin pressure and in-house chip competition from hyperscalers rather than an AI capex slowdown.

sources.title: Nvidia's Stock Is Flashing a Warning Sign as Valuation Falls

items.headline: OpenAI forms a nine-mathematician advisory board after claiming 100+ solved problems
items.why: Standing up outside math review alongside expanded safety-evaluation access suggests OpenAI is trying to get ahead of scrutiny over unverified capability claims before its next model launches.

sources.title: OpenAI News Today, September 22 | AI Weekly

items.headline: Bitcoin and ether push toward 8-month highs as 'crypto winter is over' calls resurface
items.why: A prominent analyst's call that the downturn has ended, backed by back-to-back 5-6% daily gains, marks a sentiment shift that could pull more institutional buyers off the sidelines if the move holds.

items.headline: Crypto rally accelerates on a $770 million short squeeze
items.why: With roughly 85% of the day's liquidations coming from short positions, the bounce looks driven as much by forced buying as by fresh conviction, meaning it could reverse just as fast.

items.headline: Bitcoin's rally narrows as breadth weakens near $86,000
items.why: Fewer than half the CoinDesk 100 constituents advanced even as the index itself rose, a divergence that often precedes a pause or pullback after a sharp run.

sources.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $86,000 as rally narrows and Brent slips below $100

items.headline: Fed hikes rates 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%, first increase since 2023
items.why: A unanimous vote plus a dot plot pointing to one more 2026 hike signals the Fed sees inflation risk as more pressing than growth risk right now, keeping borrowing costs elevated into next year.

sources.title: Fed raises rates by 25 basis points in first hike since July 2023

items.headline: Trump hosts Xi in Washington for a three-day summit on trade, AI and Iran
items.why: With rare-earth export limits and Taiwan both on the table, the outcome will shape whether tech and materials supply chains stay contentious or see a temporary truce heading into the midterms.

sources.title: Trump welcomes Xi to Washington for high-stakes US-China summit

items.headline: Oil slides toward $100 as Iran diplomacy and a Saudi export recovery ease supply fears
items.why: Neither development amounts to a ceasefire, but the market's willingness to price in even the possibility of de-escalation shows how stretched positioning had become after months of conflict-driven gains.

sources.title: Oil prices and the diplomatic hope that sent them sliding

items.headline: Gold steadies near $4,350 as a hawkish Fed offsets falling oil
items.why: With most Fed officials projecting another hike this year, gold's failure to rally on cheaper energy shows rate expectations, not inflation fear alone, are now the dominant driver of bullion.

sources.title: Gold Steadies Near $4,350 as Crude's Retreat Reshapes the Rate Conversation

items.headline: Copper extends its rally to a sixth straight session on Chinese refinery maintenance
items.why: Scheduled outages rather than a supply shock are tightening the market, a slower-moving but potentially more durable driver of higher prices into November.

sources.title: Copper's Sixth Straight Session Higher: What China's Supply Squeeze Is Signalling

items.headline: S&P 500 futures test 7,740-7,765 resistance after pulling back from record highs
items.why: A confirmed close above that zone would open the path back toward August's peak, while repeated rejection there would confirm sellers still control the near-term trend.

items.headline: Nasdaq closes at a record 27,244 while the S&P 500 finishes flat and the Dow slips
items.why: The split move, with chip stocks up as banks fell on rising yields, shows recent gains are increasingly concentrated in AI-linked names rather than broad-based strength.

sources.title: Nasdaq Closes at a Record as the S&P 500 Ends Flat and the Dow Slips
